source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
avoid-gobbledygook:
    description: "American English colloquialism. Use 'nonsense' instead."
    level: error
    include: ['comm/']
    type: regex
    payload: \b(gobbledy)?-?gook
    ignore-case: true
    exclude:
        - comm/tools/lint/rejected-words.yml
    # same as codespell
    extensions:
        - c
        - configure
        - cpp
        - ftl
        - h
        - html
        - idl
        - js
        - jsm
        - jxs
        - md
        - mjs
        - properties
        - py
        - rst
        - xhtml
        - xml
        - yml
        - rs
